collectRevenue().details: Reverts if the sale has not ended.Reverts if called by any other than the contract owner.Reverts if the global earnings balance is zero.Reverts if the transfer to the sender fails.An amount of REVV is transferred from this contract to the sender.

constructor.details: Reverts if `revv_` is the zero address.

consume(address,uint256).details: Reverts if the contract is paused.Reverts if sale has not started.Reverts if the sale has ended.Reverts if called by any other than a whitelisted operator.Reverts if the consumption amount is zero.Reverts if the given wallet has an insufficient balance to deduct the specified `amount` from.Reverts if the updated global earnings balance overflows.An amount of REVV is transferred from the contract to the sender.

params.wallet: The wallet from which to consume `amount` from its escrow balance.

deposit(uint256).details: Sender should ensure that this contract has a transfer allowance of at least `amount` of REVV from their account before calling this function.Reverts if the contract is paused.Reverts if the sale has started.Reverts if the sale has ended.Reverts if the deposit amount is zero.Reverts if the updated global deposit balance overflows.Reverts if the deposit transfer from the sender fails.Emits the Deposited event.An amount of REVV is transferred from the sender to this contract.

returns._0: whether the address is whitelisted operator

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Reverts if called by any other than the contract owner.Reverts if the contract is paused.Emits the Paused event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner.      * NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setSaleEnd().details: Reverts if called by any other than a whitelisted operator.Reverts if the current state is already set to SALE_END_STATE.

setSaleStart().details: Reverts if called by any other than a whitelisted operator.Reverts if the current state is already set to SALE_START_STATE.

setSaleState(uint8).details: Reverts if called by any other than the contract owner.Reverts if `_state` is not one of BEFORE_SALE_STATE, SALE_START_STATE or  SALE_END_STATE.Reverts if the current state is already set to `state_`.

params.state_: The state to set. Should be one of BEFORE_SALE_STATE, SALE_START_STATE or SALE_END_STATE.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Reverts if called by any other than the contract owner.Reverts if the contract is not paused.Emits the Unpaused event.

params.enabled: set whether the operator is enabled or disabled.
params.operator: address that will be given/removed operator right.

withdraw().details: Reverts if the sale has not ended.Reverts if the sender has no balance to withdraw from.Reverts if the transfer to the sender fails.Emits the Withdrawn event.An amount of REVV is transferred from the contract to sender.

devdoc.title: PrePaid contract. Contract which manages the deposits made by wallets for pre-sale. Participants are allowed to make deposits before the sale starts, and withdrawals after the sale ends.

collectRevenue().notice: Deducts revv escrowed by wallet and deposits to operator

consume(address,uint256).notice: Consumes a pre-paid `amount` from the specified wallet's escrow balance and updates the global earnings balance.

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposits `amount` into the sender's escrow balance and updates the global deposit balance.

getDiscount().notice: Gets the discount percentage based on the global deposit balance.

isOperator(address).notice: check whether address `who` is given operator rights.

whitelistOperator(address,bool).notice: Enable or disable address operator access

withdraw().notice: Withdraws the remainder of the sender's escrow balance to their wallet.
